entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Does not verify that a weapon is present - pair with a VLM crop question when that matters.

entries.label: Airborne phase
entries.description: Any interval where the figure has no ground contact, whether from a jump, a launch or a fall.
entries.frame_evidence: Consecutive cels show clear space under both feet and the com follows a smooth arc.
entries.detector_note: Both contact flags false for >=2 unique cels; fit com_y to a quadratic and report parabola_fit_r2 as a physical-plausibility indicator.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A low crop that excludes the ground makes contact undecidable - report not-detectable, not airborne.

entries.label: Ankle end-effector speed
entries.description: Linear speed of the foot, the quantity that separates a step from a kick or a stomp.
entries.frame_evidence: The ankle landmark travels a large normalised distance in one unique-cel step, usually with the knee leading.
entries.detector_note: |p27(t)-p27(t-1)| and |p28(t)-p28(t-1)| normalised by hip-to-ankle length per second on unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. All temporal derivatives are computed on UNIQUE-CEL indices (dedupe by mean |absdiff| < 0.5/255 against the previous frame); dt is the real gap between unique cels, never 1/fps.

entries.label: Anticipation / windup
entries.description: A short counter-directional preparation immediately before the main action, present in nearly all animated and most real strikes and throws.
entries.frame_evidence: The body pulls back or drops the opposite way for 1-4 cels before the fast forward move begins.
entries.detector_note: Detect the peak of body_action.wrist_tip_speed or body_action.ankle_tip_speed, then search backwards for a run of frames whose end-effector velocity projects negatively onto the strike direction; report its duration and amplitude.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Absent windup is a meaningful finding for animation QC but is also what a mid-action shot cut looks like.

entries.label: Arm extension (elbow angle)
entries.description: Degree of straightening of an arm, the primitive under punch, reach, throw, block and salute.
entries.frame_evidence: The shoulder-elbow-wrist triangle opens toward 180 degrees.
entries.detector_note: Interior angle at landmark 13 (left) / 14 (right) from the 11-13-15 and 12-14-16 triples using numpy.arccos of normalised dot products; velocity by finite difference on unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Backpedal / retreat
entries.description: Locomotion in the direction opposite to the body's facing, used in retreat and defensive footwork.
entries.frame_evidence: The figure travels one way while the chest and face point the other way.
entries.detector_note: Sign mismatch between com_x_velocity and the facing direction estimated from nose (0) x offset relative to the hip midpoint and shoulder ordering (x11 vs x12).
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Facing from landmark ordering flips unstably at near-profile; require agreement over 3 unique cels.

entries.label: Biomechanical plausibility of a pose
entries.description: Whether a joint configuration is anatomically possible for the character's own body.
entries.frame_evidence: A limb bends the wrong way or a joint exceeds its range in one drawing.
entries.detector_note: Would need a per-species joint-limit model plus reliable 3D joint angles; mediapipe world landmarks are far too noisy on stylised art and no anatomy prior is installed.
entries.notes: Stylisation deliberately breaks anatomy (squash, stretch, smears), so even a working detector would need a per-show tolerance - it would produce mostly false positives.

entries.label: Bite / jaw strike
entries.description: A creature or person driving open jaws onto a target.
entries.frame_evidence: The head lunges forward with the mouth wide open, then closes on contact.
entries.detector_note: VLM on a tight head crop (from mediapipe face landmarks when human, otherwise the leading silhouette extremity); corroborate with a head-region motion burst.
entries.vlm_question: Is the mouth wide open and lunging toward something as if to bite? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: THE CROP RULE applies hard here - on a full frame a small VLM will not see the jaw. moondream is unreliable on this; use qwen2.5vl.

entries.label: Block / arm guard
entries.description: Interposing a limb between an incoming strike and the body.
entries.frame_evidence: One or both forearms come up in front of the head or torso and hold there against an incoming line.
entries.detector_note: Wrists rising above shoulder height and inside the torso x-range with elbows folded below 90 degrees, held for >=2 unique cels, timed within 3 cels of a nearby impact frame.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Without the incoming strike being tracked, a guard is indistinguishable from covering the face.

entries.label: Bow
entries.description: A forward flexion of the torso from the waist or neck as a greeting or deference.
entries.frame_evidence: The upper body pitches forward around the hips while the legs stay straight and the head lowers.
entries.detector_note: torso_lean_deg increasing forward by more than 20 degrees with knee_angle staying above 160 degrees and both feet in contact, then returning.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A deep bow occludes the face and hips and destroys the skeleton at the bottom of the motion.

entries.label: Camera motion removed from body motion
entries.description: Separation of global camera pan/tilt/zoom from actual body displacement so that a moving camera is not scored as a moving actor.
entries.frame_evidence: Background features translate coherently across the frame while the figure's residual displacement differs from that global model.
entries.detector_note: cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack + cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK on the frame border band, cv2.estimateAffinePartial2D(method=cv2.RANSAC) for the global model, then warp prev with cv2.warpAffine and recompute the difference; cv2.phaseCorrelate as a cheap fallback for pure translation.
entries.notes: Fails when the figure fills most of the frame (the RANSAC majority becomes the actor) and on 2D plates where the background is a static held card while only the character layer moves.

entries.label: Carrying while moving
entries.description: Locomotion modified by a carried load: narrowed arm swing, wider stance, backward lean.
entries.frame_evidence: The arms do not counter-swing, the torso leans away from the load, and a blob stays fixed relative to the hands across the gait cycle.
entries.detector_note: Gait detected as normal, but arm_swing_amplitude below the shot's free-walk baseline and a foreground region maintaining a constant offset from the wrist landmarks over >=1 cycle.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Needs a free-walk baseline from the same character; without it the reduced arm swing has no reference.

entries.label: Carrying a person
entries.description: One figure supporting another's weight while moving - fireman's carry, bridal carry, piggyback.
entries.frame_evidence: Two overlapping figures translate together, one horizontal or elevated, with the carrier's gait widened and slowed.
entries.detector_note: VLM on the crop of the merged pair; corroborate with a merged silhouette whose combined centroid follows a single gait cycle and whose aspect ratio is unusually wide or tall.
entries.vlm_question: Is one person carrying another person in this image? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Also fires for carrying a large prop or a costume; the crop must be tight enough to show the carried figure's head.

entries.label: Catch an object
entries.description: Arresting a moving object with the hands, with the arms giving way to absorb it.
entries.frame_evidence: A travelling blob converges on the hands, stops there, and the hands recoil slightly along its former direction.
entries.detector_note: A foreground component whose trajectory terminates within a hand ROI, followed by that component moving with the wrist and a brief wrist displacement along the incoming direction (absorption).
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Fast small objects are usually not resolvable frame to frame; a drop-catch off-screen is undetectable.

entries.label: Action drawn on 2s / 3s
entries.description: The number of unique drawings per second that a given action is animated on, which gates every temporal metric in this domain.
entries.frame_evidence: A 24fps file shows each drawing held for 2 or 3 consecutive identical frames.
entries.detector_note: Duplicate-frame runs via mean |absdiff| threshold; histogram of run lengths over the shot; unique drawings per second = unique cels / duration.
entries.notes: Mandatory prerequisite for this whole domain. Optical flow between duplicates is exactly zero and that zero is an artefact. Mixed cadence (character on 2s over a background pan on 1s) breaks naive dedupe - dedupe on the character ROI, not the full frame.

entries.label: Choke hold / joint lock
entries.description: A sustained submission grip on a neck or a joint, identified by specific limb geometry between two bodies.
entries.frame_evidence: Limbs wrap a neck or hyperextend a joint while both figures are largely static.
entries.detector_note: Requires reliable multi-person part association (which limb belongs to whom) - no such model is installed; mediapipe multi-pose does not resolve interlocked bodies.
entries.notes: Known blind spot; a VLM crop question can occasionally be right here but hallucinates a named technique, so it is deliberately not offered as a vlm tier.

entries.label: Claw swipe
entries.description: A sweeping forelimb strike with an open hand or paw.
entries.frame_evidence: A forelimb arcs across frame with fingers or claws spread, often accompanied by slash-mark VFX.
entries.detector_note: VLM on the moving-limb crop; corroborate with wrist_tip_speed when the subject is humanoid enough for pose.
entries.vlm_question: Is a hand, paw or claw swinging across in a striking motion in this image? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Easily confused with the slash VFX overlay rather than the limb itself.

entries.label: Climbing
entries.description: Upward locomotion on a wall, ladder, rope or cliff using alternating hand and foot holds.
entries.frame_evidence: The body is pressed to a vertical surface, hands are above the head, and the com rises while the feet stay high on the surface.
entries.detector_note: com_y decreasing (screen up) over a long window with wrists (15/16) repeatedly above the nose (0) and ankles above the frame's lower baseline; corroborate with a VLM crop question when the surface is ambiguous.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A camera tilting down produces the same com rise unless camera compensation is applied.

entries.label: Centre-of-mass horizontal velocity
entries.description: Rate of lateral travel of the body as a whole, distinguishing travelling locomotion from in-place action.
entries.frame_evidence: The hip midpoint translates horizontally across consecutive unique cels while the background stays fixed after compensation.
entries.detector_note: d(mean(x23,x24))/dt in torso-lengths per second on unique cels, after subtracting the global_dx from body_action.camera_motion_compensation.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Centre-of-mass vertical trajectory
entries.description: Vertical path of the body centre of mass, the substrate for jump, fall, crouch and landing detection.
entries.frame_evidence: The hip midpoint rises and falls across a short window relative to its own running baseline.
entries.detector_note: mediapipe pose landmarks 23/24: com_y = mean(y23, y24); smooth with scipy.signal.savgol_filter(window=5, poly=2) over unique cels; fit a quadratic to test for free-fall curvature.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Normalise by torso length (shoulder-hip distance) so a camera dolly does not read as vertical motion.

entries.label: Crawl on hands and knees
entries.description: Quadrupedal human locomotion with hands and knees alternating contact.
entries.frame_evidence: Torso is horizontal at roughly knee height, wrists and knees alternate as the contact set.
entries.detector_note: Torso axis within 40 degrees of horizontal, hip y close to knee y, and alternating contact detected on wrists (15/16) as well as knees (25/26).
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. mediapipe is weak on quadrupedal human poses and frequently swaps left/right limbs when the body is horizontal.

entries.label: Creature limb oscillation (pose-free)
entries.description: Periodic appendage motion of a non-human body, measured from the silhouette because no skeleton fits.
entries.frame_evidence: Protrusions along the lower silhouette boundary sweep back and forth at a fixed period.
entries.detector_note: Extract the foreground contour (cv2.findContours on the MOG2 mask), sample the boundary radius profile per angle bin, and autocorrelate each bin's series over unique cels for a period and phase offset between limbs.
entries.notes: Requires a clean silhouette; a textured or same-value background makes the contour meaningless. Gives no limb identity.

entries.label: Crouch / squat down
entries.description: Lowering of the com by knee and hip flexion with the feet planted.
entries.frame_evidence: The head drops toward the hips while both feet stay in place and the knees fold.
entries.detector_note: com_y drop beyond 15 percent of the standing baseline (per-shot) with knee_angle below 120 degrees and both contact flags true.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. The standing baseline must be established per shot; a character introduced already crouching has no baseline, so report not-detectable.

entries.label: Dance / rhythmic whole-body motion
entries.description: Sustained periodic whole-body motion that is not locomotion, with limbs moving in a repeating pattern.
entries.frame_evidence: The figure moves cyclically with little net travel and multiple limbs oscillating in phase relationships.
entries.detector_note: Strong autocorrelation peak in multiple joint-angle series simultaneously (scipy.signal.correlate) with com net travel below one torso-length per cycle; report the shared period and the number of joints locked to it.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Naming the dance style requires a classifier we do not have. Repeated animation loop reuse produces a perfect periodicity that is not dancing - cross-check loop_reuse_detected.

entries.label: Dodge / evade laterally
entries.description: A fast lateral displacement of the body out of an incoming line, without a counter.
entries.frame_evidence: The torso translates sideways faster than the feet reposition, typically within 1-3 cels.
entries.detector_note: Lateral com velocity spike above the shot's locomotion maximum with a short duration and a return toward the original x, in the absence of a strike.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Whether it was a dodge depends on there being something to dodge, which is not detected.

entries.label: Double support phase
entries.description: The interval where both feet are on the ground, the discriminator between walking and running.
entries.frame_evidence: One cel shows front heel down and rear toe still down simultaneously.
entries.detector_note: Fraction of unique cels where both contact flags from body_action.foot_ground_contact are true, within a locomotion span.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Drag an object
entries.description: Moving an object along a surface with sustained hand contact and a leaning, effortful gait.
entries.frame_evidence: The figure leans away from a low trailing blob that follows along the ground at the figure's own speed.
entries.detector_note: Locomotion detected while a trailing foreground component maintains contact with the ground baseline and matches com_x_velocity, with the torso leaning opposite the drag direction.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A shadow or a cast VFX element trailing the figure produces the same correlated blob.

entries.label: Duck
entries.description: A rapid lowering of the head below an incoming horizontal line, without a full crouch hold.
entries.frame_evidence: The head drops sharply for 1-4 cels while the feet stay planted, then returns.
entries.detector_note: Nose (0) y dropping by more than 25 percent of the head-to-hip distance and returning within 6 unique cels, with contact flags unchanged.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Elbow strike
entries.description: A close-range strike delivered with the point of the elbow, the arm folded tight.
entries.frame_evidence: The elbow leads the motion across or upward while the fist stays near the shoulder.
entries.detector_note: Elbow landmark velocity exceeding wrist velocity with elbow_angle below 60 degrees through the whole window.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Arc of an extremity path
entries.description: Whether a hand or foot travels on a curved arc (natural) or a straight line (stiff/robotic), a craft observable inside any swing.
entries.frame_evidence: The plotted positions of a wrist across a short window trace a bowed path rather than a chord.
entries.detector_note: Fit a line to the wrist/ankle positions over 5-11 unique cels with numpy.polyfit; arc_sagitta = max perpendicular residual / chord length; also fit a circle for radius.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A large sagitta can also be pure landmark jitter - compare against body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null jitter floor.

entries.label: Uncontrolled fall
entries.description: Descent without propulsion or control, the body loose and orientation changing.
entries.frame_evidence: The com accelerates downward while the limbs flail and the torso axis rotates, with no takeoff extension beforehand.
entries.detector_note: Downward com acceleration approaching a constant with no preceding leg extension, plus high limb-angle variance and a rotating torso axis.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A camera tilt up mimics a fall; camera compensation is required. Stylised falls in anime are often drawn as a held pose with a moving background, which reads as zero body motion.

entries.label: Body recoil from a firearm
entries.description: The whole-body kickback following a shot: shoulders drive back, muzzle rises, sometimes a step back.
entries.frame_evidence: One or two cels after a muzzle flash the arms and shoulders translate backward and the weapon line pitches up.
entries.detector_note: Detect a frame-wide luminance spike localised near the hands (muzzle flash) then measure wrist and shoulder displacement opposite the aim direction over the next 2 unique cels plus the weapon line's angle change.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Absent recoil after a flash is a real craft finding (weightless gunplay) but also occurs when the shot is a stylised choice.

entries.label: Flinch
entries.description: A brief involuntary whole-body contraction away from a stimulus, smaller and faster than a dodge.
entries.frame_evidence: The shoulders rise, the head pulls back and the limbs draw in for 1-3 cels, then relax.
entries.detector_note: Simultaneous short-duration decrease in shoulder-to-ear distance, head retraction along the facing axis, and a drop in the sum of limb extension, all recovering within 5 unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Very close to the landmark jitter floor at small figure sizes; must clear body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null or be reported not-detectable.

entries.label: Follow-through / overshoot
entries.description: Continued travel of an extremity past the nominal end pose after the driving action stops.
entries.frame_evidence: The hand or weapon keeps going for 1-5 cels after contact, then settles back.
entries.detector_note: After the impact frame, integrate end-effector displacement until velocity drops below 10 percent of peak; overshoot = max displacement beyond the settle position.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Foot-ground contact state
entries.description: Per-foot binary of whether that foot is planted, the state machine underneath every gait, jump and landing metric.
entries.frame_evidence: The heel or toe stops moving relative to the ground plane while the rest of the body continues.
entries.detector_note: Foot is in contact when |velocity of landmarks 29/31 (or 30/32)| in camera-compensated coordinates is below 0.15 torso-lengths/s AND the foot y is within a tolerance of the per-shot maximum foot y; hysteresis over 2 unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Requires a visible ground plane and a compensated camera; on a low crop that cuts the feet this must return not-detectable rather than false.

entries.label: Foot sliding / skating
entries.description: A supporting foot that translates over the ground while nominally planted - the classic CG and retarget defect, and a deliberate effect in some 2D loops.
entries.frame_evidence: The planted foot drifts across the background texture between cels without lifting.
entries.detector_note: During a contact interval (body_action.foot_ground_contact) measure residual foot displacement in camera-compensated coordinates; slide = displacement per contact frame / stride_length.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Camera compensation error is directly reported as slide; require inlier_ratio > 0.6 from the compensation step or mark not-detectable.

entries.label: Heel strike and toe off
entries.description: The two discrete events that bound a stance phase, needed to time impacts, sound and dust puffs.
entries.frame_evidence: The heel lands (heel stops, toe still up) then later the toe leaves (heel already up, toe last to move).
entries.detector_note: Transitions in body_action.foot_ground_contact split by heel (29/30) versus foot_index (31/32) velocity ordering within the transition window.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Needs the feet visible and reasonably large in frame; below ~80px of leg the heel/toe ordering is noise.

entries.label: Front kick
entries.description: A kick driven straight forward in the sagittal plane, knee lifting then the shin snapping out.
entries.frame_evidence: The knee rises in front of the body and the foot extends toward the camera-forward direction with the hips square.
entries.detector_note: Knee y above hip y at chamber, ankle x displacement mainly along the facing direction, hip line staying square (small change in shoulder_hip_angle_deg), knee extending past 150 degrees.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Front kicks aimed at camera are heavily foreshortened and can score as a knee raise; use the VLM crop as a tiebreak.

entries.label: Gait cadence
entries.description: Steps per second, the scalar that orders walk, jog, run and sprint on one axis.
entries.frame_evidence: Repeating footfall events at a measurable interval.
entries.detector_note: scipy.signal.find_peaks on the signed ankle-separation series (x27-x28), cadence = peaks per second on unique-cel timestamps.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. All temporal derivatives are computed on UNIQUE-CEL indices (dedupe by mean |absdiff| < 0.5/255 against the previous frame); dt is the real gap between unique cels, never 1/fps.

entries.label: Getting up from the ground
entries.description: The transition from lying to standing, through a push-up, a kip-up or a roll to the knees.
entries.frame_evidence: The horizontal silhouette becomes vertical over a short span, with the wrists loaded first.
entries.detector_note: Torso axis rotating from near-horizontal to near-vertical with com_y rising, preceded by wrist contact at ground level.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Grapple / clinch / hold
entries.description: Sustained mutual contact between two figures with entangled limbs and low net travel.
entries.frame_evidence: Two figures overlap for many cels with high internal limb motion but a nearly stationary combined centroid.
entries.detector_note: Detect a persistent merged silhouette with high internal motion energy and low centroid travel, then confirm the interaction with a VLM crop of the merged region.
entries.vlm_question: Are two people holding on to each other and struggling in this image? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Pose estimation on interlocked bodies routinely fuses limbs from both people into one skeleton - do not trust landmark metrics inside a clinch.

entries.label: Grasp / hand closes on an object
entries.description: The hand closing around something, the moment a body action becomes an object action.
entries.frame_evidence: The fingers fold around a shape and the hand thereafter moves with that object.
entries.detector_note: mediapipe HandLandmarker: fingertip-to-palm distances (landmarks 4/8/12/16/20 vs 0) collapsing below a per-shot open-hand baseline; corroborate by the object and hand sharing a motion vector afterwards.
entries.notes: HandLandmarker needs a reasonably large, unblurred hand; at action speed and on 2D art with mitten-shaped hands this fails outright and must report not-detectable.

entries.label: Combat guard stance (held)
entries.description: A held ready posture: weight split, knees bent, hands up, body bladed.
entries.frame_evidence: Several cels with hands at chest/head height, elbows in, knees softly bent and low overall motion.
entries.detector_note: Low motion energy over >=4 unique cels while wrists are above hip height and inside the shoulder x-range and knee_angle is between 140 and 170 degrees.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Hanging / dangling
entries.description: Static suspension from the hands with the body loaded downward.
entries.frame_evidence: Arms are fully extended overhead, the body hangs vertically below the hands, and the legs are unsupported.
entries.detector_note: elbow_angle near 180, wrists above shoulders above hips in a near-vertical column, no foot contact, low overall motion energy with a slight pendulum sway.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Hard / three-point landing pose
entries.description: The stylised crouched landing with one fist and both feet down, near-universal in action animation.
entries.frame_evidence: A single held frame with one hand on the ground, deep knee bend, head down, often with a dust ring.
entries.detector_note: VLM on the figure crop at the frame following touchdown; corroborate with a wrist landmark whose y is at ground level and a deep knee angle.
entries.vlm_question: Is the person crouching low with one hand touching the ground? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: THE CROP RULE: ask on the figure crop. Pose alone confuses this with a kneel or a sprint start.

entries.label: Headbutt
entries.description: A strike delivered by driving the head forward or downward into a target.
entries.frame_evidence: The head accelerates ahead of the torso and stops abruptly at a contact point.
entries.detector_note: Nose (0) displacement relative to mid_shoulder exceeding a threshold with the head leading the com, terminating in a velocity collapse at an impact frame.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Easily confused with a lunge or a nod; require the impact anchor.

entries.label: Hit stop / impact hold
entries.description: The deliberate 1-6 frame freeze right after a strike lands, a stylistic marker heavy in anime and games.
entries.frame_evidence: Several consecutive frames are near-identical immediately after an impact spike, then motion resumes.
entries.detector_note: Run duplicate-frame detection (mean |absdiff| below threshold) and measure the run length starting within 2 cels of an impact_frame_index; report hold duration in source frames and in unique cels.
entries.notes: On 2D content a hold is indistinguishable from ordinary limited animation unless it is anchored to an impact; always require the impact anchor.

entries.label: Idle breathing / micro-motion
entries.description: The low-amplitude motion of a nominally still character, whose absence is the difference between a living hold and a frozen frame.
entries.frame_evidence: Across several cels the chest and shoulders drift by a few pixels in a slow cycle while everything else is still.
entries.detector_note: Camera-compensated mean |absdiff| restricted to the torso ROI, band-limited by scipy.signal to a slow period; report amplitude in pixels and the period, against a true-duplicate zero baseline.
entries.notes: The single easiest place to report a fake number: a value near the duplicate-frame baseline means nothing. Report not-detectable when amplitude is within noise of that baseline.

entries.label: Impact frame
entries.description: The single frame where a motion is abruptly arrested, the signature of any contact event.
entries.frame_evidence: Motion energy spikes and then collapses within one or two cels, often with a flash, shake or debris on the same frame.
entries.detector_note: scipy.signal.find_peaks on the camera-compensated motion-energy series with a required drop of >60 percent within 2 unique cels; corroborate with a frame-wide luminance jump (numpy.mean) and a global_dx/dy spike from camera compensation (impact shake).
entries.notes: Cannot say WHAT hit what, or whether contact was real - a hard cut produces the same signature. Cross-check against a shot-boundary list.

entries.label: Joint velocity reversal
entries.description: The instant a joint stops going one way and goes the other, the boundary marker between windup, action and recovery.
entries.frame_evidence: A limb reaches its extreme pose in one frame and is moving back the other way in the next.
entries.detector_note: Sign change in the first difference of each joint angle series on unique cels, requiring |velocity| on both sides to exceed the jitter floor.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Jump apex / hang
entries.description: The topmost frame of an airborne arc, often deliberately held in stylised animation.
entries.frame_evidence: One cel sits at the peak with near-zero vertical velocity, sometimes held for extra frames.
entries.detector_note: argmax of the smoothed com_y (screen-up) series inside an airborne span; hang = count of consecutive cels within 5 percent of that peak.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. An unnaturally long hang is a stylistic finding, not an error - report the number, do not judge it.

entries.label: Jump takeoff
entries.description: The propulsive phase where the legs extend and the last foot leaves the ground.
entries.frame_evidence: A crouch is followed within 1-4 cels by full leg extension and the loss of both foot contacts.
entries.detector_note: Sequence detector: com_y minimum (lowest point) then knee_angle rising past 160 degrees then both contact flags going false, all inside 6 unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Kick contact / connection
entries.description: The frame at which a kicking foot actually meets a target rather than passing through empty air.
entries.frame_evidence: The foot is coincident with a second body or object on the impact cel, and its motion is arrested there.
entries.detector_note: Take the impact_frame_index from the deterministic detector, crop a box around the striking foot (from landmarks 27/28, 1.5x torso-width), and ask the VLM; corroborate with the ankle velocity collapse.
entries.vlm_question: Is the foot touching another person or object in this image? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: THE CROP RULE. Whiff versus connect is genuinely ambiguous at speed and behind smear/impact VFX; expect false positives when an impact flash covers the contact point.

entries.label: Knee strike
entries.description: A short-range strike delivered with the knee driven upward or forward.
entries.frame_evidence: The knee rises sharply toward hip height or above while the shin stays folded.
entries.detector_note: Knee y rising rapidly while knee_angle stays below 90 degrees (folded), distinguishing it from a kick where the angle opens.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Kneel on both knees
entries.description: Posture with both knees on the ground and the torso upright.
entries.frame_evidence: Both knees are at ground level, the shins are hidden or horizontal, and the torso stays vertical.
entries.detector_note: Both knee y values near the lowest body point, ankles behind/below the knees, torso_lean_deg near vertical.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Occluded shins are common; mediapipe hallucinates ankle positions behind the body.

entries.label: Kneel on one knee
entries.description: Posture with one knee on the ground and the other foot planted, common in bows, proposals and combat rests.
entries.frame_evidence: One knee sits at ground level while the opposite foot is flat and forward.
entries.detector_note: One knee landmark y within a tolerance of the contacting ankle y while the contralateral knee is high and its ankle is in contact.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Knockback / launch from a hit
entries.description: Involuntary airborne travel away from an impact point.
entries.frame_evidence: Immediately after an impact frame the figure translates rapidly away from the contact direction, feet leaving the ground.
entries.detector_note: Within 2 unique cels of an impact_frame_index, com velocity jumps above the shot's locomotion maximum with both contact flags false and no preceding leg extension.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Attribution of WHO caused the knockback needs multi-person tracking we do not have (see body_action.multi_person_interaction_attribution).

entries.label: Knockdown to the ground
entries.description: A struck figure going from upright to on the ground.
entries.frame_evidence: Within a short window the torso axis rotates from vertical to horizontal and the com lands at the shot's ground baseline.
entries.detector_note: Torso axis change of more than 55 degrees toward horizontal with com_y reaching the ground baseline within 10 unique cels of an impact frame.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Pose tracking degrades badly through the fall; fall back to body_action.roll_forward_breakfall silhouette geometry when visibility drops.

entries.label: Landing absorption
entries.description: The knee-and-hip flexion after touchdown that absorbs the impact, whose absence reads as weightless or stiff animation.
entries.frame_evidence: In the 1-5 cels after touchdown the knees bend and the com dips below the standing baseline before recovering.
entries.detector_note: Measure com_y dip depth and knee_angle minimum in the 6 unique cels after touchdown_frame; absorption_ratio = dip depth / descent velocity.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A zero dip is a genuine craft finding (no weight) but is also what a cut-on-landing looks like.

entries.label: Landing touchdown
entries.description: The frame where the first foot regains contact after an airborne phase.
entries.frame_evidence: The descending figure's foot meets the ground, usually with an impact accent (dust, shake, hold).
entries.detector_note: First contact flag returning true at the end of an airborne span; cross-check with body_action.impact_frame_detection within +/-1 unique cel.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Slip / lean away
entries.description: Bending the torso backward or sideways at the waist to let a strike pass.
entries.frame_evidence: The torso axis swings away from vertical while the feet remain planted.
entries.detector_note: Rapid change in torso_lean_deg (>25 degrees within 3 unique cels) with no com_x travel and both feet in contact.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Broad jump / leap across
entries.description: A jump whose horizontal travel dominates its height, used for gaps and dives.
entries.frame_evidence: The body travels a large horizontal distance while airborne with the legs trailing.
entries.detector_note: Within an airborne span, ratio of com_x displacement to com_y apex height, both in torso-lengths.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Leg extension (knee angle)
entries.description: Degree of straightening of a leg, the primitive under kick, jump takeoff, stomp and stand-up.
entries.frame_evidence: The hip-knee-ankle triangle opens toward 180 degrees, usually within 2-4 unique cels.
entries.detector_note: Interior angle at landmark 25/26 from the 23-25-27 and 24-26-28 triples; peak angular rate over the action window.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Leg extension velocity (kick primitive)
entries.description: The scalar shared by all kicks: how fast the shin whips out from the knee.
entries.frame_evidence: The shin segment sweeps through a large angle in one or two cels, usually with a smear.
entries.detector_note: d(knee_angle)/dt on unique cels for the striking leg, plus ankle_tip_speed; report peak and the frame of peak.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. All temporal derivatives are computed on UNIQUE-CEL indices (dedupe by mean |absdiff| < 0.5/255 against the previous frame); dt is the real gap between unique cels, never 1/fps.

entries.label: Leg sweep / trip attack
entries.description: A low horizontal leg arc aimed at the opponent's base.
entries.frame_evidence: The kicking foot skims near ground level across a wide lateral arc, often with the body dropped low.
entries.detector_note: Ankle travelling laterally with y held near the ground baseline while com_y is depressed; arc angle above 60 degrees.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Lying down (prone or supine)
entries.description: A body whose long axis is roughly horizontal and resting on the ground.
entries.frame_evidence: The whole figure is a long horizontal shape at the bottom of the frame with a static com.
entries.detector_note: Torso axis (mid_shoulder to mid_hip) within 30 degrees of the image horizontal, low com variance, silhouette aspect ratio wide; use the VLM sibling to resolve prone versus supine.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Prone versus supine cannot be decided from 2D landmarks - that requires a VLM crop question or is not-detectable.

entries.label: Lift an object
entries.description: Raising an object against gravity, with the body's posture showing the load.
entries.frame_evidence: The hands rise from a low position while the legs extend and the back angle changes; a separate blob rises with the hands.
entries.detector_note: Coincident wrist y rise and knee extension from a crouch, with a non-body foreground component rising at the same velocity as the wrists (mask-difference correlation).
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Whether the object is heavy cannot be measured - see body_action.action_force_magnitude.

entries.label: Peak limb angular velocity
entries.description: How fast a limb segment sweeps, the scalar that separates a gesture from a strike.
entries.frame_evidence: A limb segment rotates through a large angle between two adjacent unique cels.
entries.detector_note: For each segment (upper arm, forearm, thigh, shin) compute segment angle via arctan2 then d(angle)/dt on unique-cel timestamps; report the 95th percentile and the argmax frame index.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. All temporal derivatives are computed on UNIQUE-CEL indices (dedupe by mean |absdiff| < 0.5/255 against the previous frame); dt is the real gap between unique cels, never 1/fps. Motion blur and smear frames displace the landmark and inflate this value.

entries.label: Limb smear / multiple frame
entries.description: The single drawn frame where a fast limb is stretched, ghosted or multiplied into a directional blur instead of drawn solidly.
entries.frame_evidence: One cel contains an elongated, directionally streaked or duplicated limb shape that neither neighbouring cel contains.
entries.detector_note: In the moving ROI, skimage.feature.structure_tensor + structure_tensor_eigenvalues to get orientation coherence; flag frames where coherence and elongation exceed both neighbours and the streak axis aligns with the end-effector velocity direction.
entries.notes: Real motion blur in live action and heavy 3D shutter produce the same statistic - use applies_to and a per-shot baseline; hatching, speed lines and rain also fire this.

entries.label: Limp / asymmetric gait
entries.description: Uneven gait where one leg bears load for a shorter time, signalling injury or a character trait.
entries.frame_evidence: One foot is planted noticeably longer than the other, and the torso dips toward the strong side.
entries.detector_note: Ratio of mean stance duration left vs right over >=3 cycles, plus per-side torso_lean_deg at midstance; flag when ratio departs from 1.0 beyond the shot's cycle-to-cycle variance.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Needs at least three clean cycles; a single occluded stride produces the same asymmetry statistic. A camera at an oblique angle biases one side's apparent stance.

entries.label: Locomotion periodicity (pose-free)
entries.description: Repetition period of any cyclic gross-motor locomotion, measured without a skeleton so it works on anime, creatures and crowds.
entries.frame_evidence: The frame content repeats at a fixed interval - a cycled walk, run, flap or swim.
entries.detector_note: Autocorrelation (scipy.signal.correlate) of the per-unique-cel motion-energy series and of the silhouette-width series; peak lag = cycle period; also detect exact loop reuse via frame-hash recurrence.
entries.notes: Strong peaks also come from a repeated background pan or a flickering light; require the peak to survive camera compensation.

entries.label: Global body motion energy
entries.description: Total amount of pixel change attributable to a moving body in the frame, the coarsest signal that any gross motor action is happening at all.
entries.frame_evidence: A dense region of changed pixels between two consecutive unique cels, concentrated on a figure rather than spread over the whole plate.
entries.detector_note: cv2.absdiff on 8-bit grey, cv2.GaussianBlur(5,5), cv2.threshold(...,cv2.THRESH_OTSU), then energy = changed_px_count and mean |I_t - I_t-1| inside the largest cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats blob; run only after body_action.camera_motion_compensation.
entries.notes: Zero between two duplicate cels is an artefact, not stillness. All temporal derivatives are computed on UNIQUE-CEL indices (dedupe by mean |absdiff| < 0.5/255 against the previous frame); dt is the real gap between unique cels, never 1/fps.

entries.label: Who acted on whom
entries.description: Assigning an action and its target across multiple figures - which character threw the punch and which one received it.
entries.frame_evidence: Two or more figures overlap and exchange contact within the same frames.
entries.detector_note: Needs a person detector plus a stable multi-object tracker with re-identification across occlusion; ultralytics and insightface are not installed and mediapipe multi-pose does not maintain identity through a clinch or a cut.
entries.notes: Every strike/contact entry in this domain therefore reports geometry and contact, never an attacker and a victim.

entries.label: Parry / deflection
entries.description: A short lateral limb or weapon motion that redirects an incoming line rather than absorbing it.
entries.frame_evidence: A quick sideways sweep of the forearm or blade intersects the incoming path and the attacker's line changes.
entries.detector_note: Detect a short high-velocity lateral wrist sweep coincident with an impact frame, then confirm with a VLM crop of the contact region.
entries.vlm_question: Are two people's arms or weapons striking against each other in this image? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Parry versus block versus clash cannot be separated reliably; the entry reports the geometry and defers the label.

entries.label: Figure present at all
entries.description: The prerequisite null: whether any human or humanoid figure is in frame, so absence is logged as not-applicable rather than not-found.
entries.frame_evidence: A recognisable figure occupies part of the frame.
entries.detector_note: mediapipe Tasks PoseLandmarker(num_poses=4) presence/visibility above threshold on a downscaled frame; escalate to a VLM yes/no on the full frame when pose fails but motion energy is high (stylised or non-human subject).
entries.notes: No person detector is installed (no ultralytics), so crowd counting and small-in-frame figures are unreliable; num_poses>1 tracking identity across cuts is not maintained.

entries.label: Pivot / direction change
entries.description: A planted-foot rotation that changes the direction the body faces or travels.
entries.frame_evidence: One foot stays fixed while the body rotates around it and the shoulder line sweeps through a large angle.
entries.detector_note: One contact flag stays true across the window while shoulder_line_angle changes by more than 30 degrees and shoulder_foreshorten_ratio passes through a minimum (profile).
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Yaw through the camera axis is only inferred from foreshortening, so a 180 degree turn and a 0 degree turn can look alike at the endpoints - require the mid-window profile.

entries.label: Pose landmark null model
entries.description: The explicit null model for every landmark-tier entry: how much of the measured motion is landmark jitter rather than body motion.
entries.frame_evidence: On a genuinely static held frame the skeleton still wobbles by some number of pixels - that number is the noise floor.
entries.detector_note: Run mediapipe pose over a run of duplicate cels and over a shot with no figure; report per-landmark visibility, presence, and the standard deviation of each landmark position across identical frames as the jitter floor every threshold must clear.
entries.notes: Mandatory. Without this floor, every velocity and angle metric in this domain emits confident numbers that mean nothing, especially on 2D art where mediapipe returns a plausible skeleton for a background prop.

entries.label: Prone / commando crawl
entries.description: Locomotion with the torso dragging on the ground, propelled by forearms and inner legs.
entries.frame_evidence: The whole body silhouette is low and horizontal, com barely rises, elbows drive forward alternately.
entries.detector_note: Crop the figure bbox from the pose or silhouette and ask the VLM; corroborate with a very low silhouette aspect ratio and small com_y variance.
entries.vlm_question: Is the person lying flat on their stomach and pulling themselves forward along the ground? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Pose landmarks are unreliable at this orientation, so the VLM is primary and the geometry is only corroboration. THE CROP RULE: ask on a tight figure crop, never the full plate.

entries.label: Hook punch
entries.description: A curved horizontal strike with the elbow held bent throughout and the torso rotating.
entries.frame_evidence: The fist swings on a lateral arc while the elbow stays around 90 degrees and the shoulders rotate.
entries.detector_note: Wrist path arc_sagitta_ratio above the straight-punch threshold while elbow_angle stays between 70 and 120 degrees and shoulder_line_angle sweeps.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Punch retraction / recovery
entries.description: The return of the fist to guard after a strike, whose absence reads as a stiff or unfinished action.
entries.frame_evidence: Within 1-5 cels of full extension the hand travels back toward the chest.
entries.detector_note: Velocity reversal at peak extension followed by wrist displacement back toward the shoulder; report the retraction duration and whether it completes before the shot ends.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Straight punch / jab / cross
entries.description: A linear strike where the fist travels along the shoulder-to-target axis with the elbow extending.
entries.frame_evidence: The arm goes from folded to nearly straight in 1-3 cels with the fist leading and the shoulder driving forward.
entries.detector_note: elbow_angle rising past 155 degrees with the wrist displacement vector aligned (cos > 0.85) to the shoulder-to-wrist axis, and peak wrist_tip_speed within the same window.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Uppercut
entries.description: A rising strike from below with the elbow bent and the legs driving upward.
entries.frame_evidence: The fist travels vertically upward from hip level with the body extending from a slight crouch.
entries.detector_note: Wrist displacement dominated by the upward component from below hip height, elbow_angle below 110 degrees, coincident com_y rise.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Quadruped gait (walk/trot/canter/gallop)
entries.description: Which four-legged gait a creature is using, distinguished by footfall order and suspension phases.
entries.frame_evidence: The footfall sequence and the presence or absence of a suspension frame differ per gait.
entries.detector_note: Needs an animal-pose keypoint model (no ultralytics/animal-pose network installed); nothing in the current stack localises quadruped limbs reliably.
entries.notes: Logged as a known blind spot. The deterministic sibling body_action.creature_limb_oscillation gives only a period, never a gait name.

entries.label: Ragdoll tumble / body roll after impact
entries.description: Passive multi-axis rotation of a limp body across the ground after being struck or dropped.
entries.frame_evidence: The whole silhouette rotates repeatedly with limbs trailing passively and no self-driven pose.
entries.detector_note: VLM on the figure crop plus silhouette orientation (skimage.measure.regionprops orientation) unwrapping through more than 180 degrees over the window.
entries.vlm_question: Is the person's body tumbling limply along the ground without controlling their limbs? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Pose tracking fails through rotation; the silhouette orientation is ambiguous modulo 180 degrees and must be unwrapped carefully.

entries.label: Reach toward something
entries.description: Directed extension of an arm toward a target, the opening of every grasp, throw or handover.
entries.frame_evidence: The hand travels away from the body along a straight-ish path with the elbow opening and the torso often leaning after it.
entries.detector_note: Monotonic increase in shoulder-to-wrist distance over >=3 unique cels with a low arc_sagitta_ratio, terminating in a velocity decay rather than a reversal.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. The target object is not detected (no object detector installed), so the reach direction is reported but never the referent.

entries.label: Recoil from an impact
entries.description: The passive backward displacement of a body part or the whole body caused by a received hit.
entries.frame_evidence: Within one cel of an impact frame the struck region snaps away from the contact direction and then oscillates back.
entries.detector_note: At impact_frame_index, measure the displacement of the nearest body region opposite the strike direction over the next 3 unique cels, plus the settle oscillation count.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Requires the impact anchor; without it a recoil is just motion.

entries.label: Roll / breakfall
entries.description: A controlled rotation of the whole body over the ground, used to absorb a landing or to close distance.
entries.frame_evidence: The silhouette compacts into a ball and rotates through more than 180 degrees along a travel path.
entries.detector_note: Silhouette compactness (4*pi*area/perimeter^2) rising toward 1 while regionprops orientation unwraps through >180 degrees and the centroid translates.
entries.notes: Needs a clean silhouette and a camera-compensated stream. Pose tracking is useless through the roll, so this is deliberately silhouette-based.

entries.label: Roundhouse kick
entries.description: A kick swung on a horizontal arc with the hips rotating over the support leg.
entries.frame_evidence: The support foot pivots, the hips and shoulders rotate strongly, and the leg sweeps laterally across frame.
entries.detector_note: Large hip-line rotation (shoulder_hip_angle_deg and hip_line_angle both sweeping >45 degrees) concurrent with a lateral ankle arc, support foot contact maintained with a pivot.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Distinguishing roundhouse from hook kick and from a wheel kick reliably needs a trained action classifier; this entry only separates rotational from linear kicks.

entries.label: Run
entries.description: Bipedal locomotion with an airborne phase between contacts and a forward torso lean.
entries.frame_evidence: One or more cels show both feet clear of the ground between alternating contacts, arms counter-swinging.
entries.detector_note: Alternating contacts with a non-zero flight phase (both contact flags false for >=1 unique cel), torso_lean_deg forward beyond the walk baseline, and cadence above ~2.2 steps/s.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Anime runs are often drawn on 3s with only 2 unique poses per cycle, which can erase the flight phase from the sampled cels.

entries.label: Airborne phase in running
entries.description: The interval where neither foot touches, present in run and sprint and absent in walk.
entries.frame_evidence: One or more cels show a visible gap under both feet.
entries.detector_note: Runs of unique cels with both contact flags false while com_x_velocity remains high; corroborate with a rise in com_y.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Salute
entries.description: A hand brought to the brow or chest and held, with the body coming to attention.
entries.frame_evidence: One hand rises to head height near the brow and holds while the body is still and upright.
entries.detector_note: Wrist landmark entering a head ROI (built from landmarks 0/7/8) and staying for >=3 unique cels, with elbow angle around 45-90 degrees, torso vertical and low motion energy.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Indistinguishable from shading the eyes, adjusting a hat or a head scratch without a VLM tiebreak.

entries.label: Seated posture
entries.description: A held seated pose, distinguished from a crouch by the thigh being horizontal and the com being stable.
entries.frame_evidence: Thighs horizontal, shins roughly vertical, torso upright, com steady over several cels.
entries.detector_note: Thigh segment (23-25) within 25 degrees of horizontal, hip y above ankle y by less than half a leg length, low com variance over the window.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Serpentine / slither locomotion
entries.description: Limbless lateral-wave locomotion of a snake-like body.
entries.frame_evidence: A travelling sinusoid runs along the body's medial axis while the whole shape translates.
entries.detector_note: Skeletonise the foreground mask (skimage.morphology.skeletonize), fit the medial axis, measure lateral curvature along arclength and track phase travel of the curvature maxima across unique cels.
entries.notes: Only valid on a clean single-subject silhouette; overlapping coils break the skeleton.

entries.label: Set an object down
entries.description: Controlled lowering of a carried object to a surface, ending with the hands releasing.
entries.frame_evidence: The hands descend at a controlled rate, stop at surface height, then withdraw while the object stays put.
entries.detector_note: Wrist y descent terminating in a plateau, followed by wrist displacement away from a foreground region that stops moving; contrast with a drop, where the object velocity increases after release.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Distinguishing set-down from drop needs the object to remain segmentable after release.

entries.label: Shove / push a person
entries.description: Two-handed or one-handed push that displaces another figure without a strike arc.
entries.frame_evidence: Extended arms meet a second figure, which then translates away while the pusher's arms straighten.
entries.detector_note: Detect arm extension toward a second pose (Tasks PoseLandmarker num_poses>=2), then confirm with a VLM crop covering both figures.
entries.vlm_question: Is one person pushing another person away with their hands? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: Multi-person landmark association across cels is not maintained, so which figure moved is inferred from proximity only.

entries.label: Shrug
entries.description: A brief symmetric elevation of both shoulders, usually with the elbows tucked and palms turning up.
entries.frame_evidence: The shoulder landmarks rise toward the ears for 2-6 cels and drop back.
entries.detector_note: Decrease in the shoulder-to-ear (11/12 vs 7/8) vertical distance of more than 15 percent of head height, symmetric within 30 percent, recovering within 8 unique cels.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Small in pixels; must clear the jitter floor from body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. A camera push-in mimics the rise unless normalised by head height.

entries.label: Side kick
entries.description: A linear kick delivered with the body turned side-on, the heel leading.
entries.frame_evidence: The torso is in profile, the kicking leg extends along the body's lateral axis, and the support foot points away.
entries.detector_note: Shoulder_foreshorten_ratio at a shot minimum (profile) while knee extends past 160 degrees and the ankle travels along the shoulder-line axis.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Sidestep / lateral shuffle
entries.description: Lateral locomotion without crossing the feet and without turning the body.
entries.frame_evidence: Both feet move sideways in sequence while shoulders stay square to camera.
entries.detector_note: com_x_velocity above threshold while shoulder-line angle and shoulder_foreshorten_ratio stay constant and ankle separation oscillates along x only.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null.

entries.label: Silhouette centroid displacement
entries.description: Centre-of-mass proxy taken from the moving-figure silhouette, usable when no skeleton can be fitted (anime, creatures, crowds).
entries.frame_evidence: The area-weighted centroid of the foreground blob shifts frame to frame.
entries.detector_note: cv2.createBackgroundSubtractorMOG2(history=200, varThreshold=25, detectShadows=False) on a camera-compensated stream, largest component via cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats, centroid and area from its stats; skimage.measure.regionprops for orientation.
entries.notes: Needs a near-static camera and a background that actually differs from the character; flat anime colour fields with a same-hue costume merge the figure into the plate.

entries.label: Sitting down
entries.description: The transition from standing to seated, with the com descending backwards onto a support.
entries.frame_evidence: The hips travel down and back, the thighs rotate toward horizontal, and the descent stops abruptly at seat height.
entries.detector_note: com_y descent that terminates at a stable plateau above ground level, hip-knee segment rotating toward horizontal, feet remaining in contact.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. The chair or ledge is not detected; sitting on nothing visible looks identical.

entries.label: Skid / abrupt deceleration
entries.description: A rapid arrest of forward locomotion with the feet sliding and the torso pitching back.
entries.frame_evidence: Feet slide forward of the com while the body leans back, often with a dust or speed-line accent.
entries.detector_note: Large negative d(com_x_velocity)/dt over 1-3 unique cels combined with high slide_per_contact_norm and a backwards torso_lean_deg swing.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Overlaps with a camera whip; require the compensation inlier_ratio to be high.

entries.label: Slap / open-hand strike
entries.description: A swinging strike delivered with an open palm rather than a fist.
entries.frame_evidence: The hand arcs across with the fingers visibly extended and spread at contact.
entries.detector_note: Detect the swing with wrist_tip_speed and arc_sagitta_ratio, then crop the hand from landmark 15/16 (or mediapipe HandLandmarker when it locks) and ask the VLM about the hand shape.
entries.vlm_question: Is the hand open with the fingers extended, rather than closed into a fist? Answer yes or no.
entries.notes: THE CROP RULE. At strike speed the hand is smeared or motion-blurred, and hand-shape questions on a blurred crop are unreliable - expect low confidence.

entries.label: Slip
entries.description: A support foot sliding out from under the body, with the com dropping backwards.
entries.frame_evidence: The planted foot shoots forward relative to the body while the torso pitches back and the arms fly up.
entries.detector_note: High slide_per_contact_norm in the direction of travel combined with a backward torso_lean_deg swing and a rapid com_y drop.
entries.notes: mediapipe pose is trained on photographic humans; on stylised 2D art, chibi proportions, masks, heavy occlusion or non-human anatomy it silently returns a low-visibility or hallucinated skeleton - gate every landmark metric on body_action.pose_landmark_confidence_null. Shares its whole signature with body_action.skid_stop except for the com drop; require the drop.

entries.label: Snap / high kick
entries.description: A fast kick that reaches head height and immediately retracts.
entries.frame_evidence: The foot rises above the character's own shoulder line for one or two cels then returns.
entries.detector_note: Ankle y above shoulder y for >=1 unique cel with a retraction (velocity reversal) within 3 cels; height normalised by standing height.
